verdict.rationale: Statsig documents both client and server SDKs that evaluate locally after initialization. Its docs state that evaluation is deterministic and returns the same result across platforms (client or server), which directly addresses consistent flag behavior. Web is covered by the JavaScript and React (StatsigProvider) SDKs, and backend by the server SDKs. Missing for 10: an explicit list of official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/React Native), a documented list of supported backend languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-platform consistency.
